independence_claim: The runtime attempted independent direct retrieval of the public URLs using web-browsing capabilities. The preview hosts were inaccessible in that execution environment, so the analysis remained bounded to operator-relayed strings.
limitations: Direct network-level retrieval of the branch preview, live thread, and JSON artifacts failed in the tested Gemini/Google retrieval environments.
Unable to verify live state continuity, message sequence increments, or real-time cryptographic values.
Data evaluation was constrained to operator-relayed text.
finding: Cryptographic and structural validation could not be independently completed. The runtime correctly refused to treat relayed strings as network verification.

proposed_commons_message.content: External runtime retrieval indicates the preview hostnames are inaccessible in this environment. Request an alternative first-party public mirror or static evidence bridge to permit blind-first cross-verification of the durable thread state.
